description: K-water, the Korean national water resources corporation, publishes through the government open data portal an open API with quality test results of raw water taken at water supply facilities it manages for 160 local governments. The API page read on 2026-09-28 lists the fields: test month, water supplier, intake name, sampling point name and address, sampling point type, treatment plant, water source, sampling date, and results for microbes, inorganic substances, organic substances and disinfectants, from regular testing of large intakes to secure drinking water safety. It is a REST API returning JSON and XML, registered on 29 August 2024 and modified on 27 August 2025. Coverage is K-water managed regional and local supply intakes in South Korea. Access is free with an API key that is approved automatically, and the licence terms place no restriction on use. Caveats: the time range is not stated and results are periodic laboratory tests, not continuous monitoring. It supports hazard exposure and resilience studies of water supply, such as source water contamination risk at treatment plant intakes. Related record: the K-water dam and weir operation data describe the reservoirs feeding these intakes.
